craft_notes: Sthāyin: climbing resolve (the ladder's lower half). Sanskrit first: four stations (navel, heart-grandsire, throat-unfallen, palate-Rudra) → L4 sets two stations per line, epithets untranslated. Rows: row 2 (deity-names never split from their stations). Rupture: semicolon after 'heart' — lower climb done, upper begins. Close: end-weight on the arch ('palate arches' — tālutale as architecture). Minimal pass: 'old sire' avoided — kept 'grandsire' (L0 epithet-literal, sings fine). Read aloud: line 1 pierces twice (navel/heart stressed), line 2 beholds (unfailing/face-to-face long). Rejected: 'Brahma/Vishnu' for pitāmaha/acyuta — killed at L0 (ladder rungs, not gods); 'kiss the palate' — killed: sthitam stands, song stands.

lines: From the Bulb, pierce the navel, then the grandsire of the heart;
the unfailing in the throat, Rudra face to face where palate arches.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kandastho vedhayen nābhiṃ tato hṛtsthaṃ pitāmaham / kaṇṭhasthamacyutaṃ sākṣādrudraṃ tālutale sthitam

reads_against.argmap: Awakening pierces upward station by station: navel, heart, throat, palate.
c1_essence: Bulb-rooted piercing: navel, heart-grandsire, throat-unfallen, palate Rudra.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta strained toward bhayānaka (wonder edged with fear)
